working_on.task: Chuẩn hóa định dạng Excel BOM (No Scaling, Fixed Width)
working_on.notes: Đã release v0.2.75. Tổng chiều rộng 3 sheet = 135 units, cân đối A4 Landscape.

recent_changes.description: Fixed total width = 135 units across all 3 sheets (min=max to disable dynamic sizing)
Resolved Mojibake encoding (UTF-8 BOM corruption) and reapplied No Scaling formatting
Standardized A4 Landscape, 9pt TNR, Scale=100, FitToPage=false for all sheets

decisions_made.decision: Set total table width = 135 units across all 3 Excel sheets
decisions_made.reason: 135 units = 243mm, fits 93% of A4 Landscape printable area (261mm). Ensures all sheets have identical right-edge alignment.

decisions_made.decision: Use fixed widths (minWidth = maxWidth) to disable dynamic column sizing
decisions_made.reason: Dynamic AutoFit caused inconsistent table widths between sheets depending on data content.

decisions_made.decision: Font 9pt Times New Roman + Scale 100% (No Scaling) for all sheets
decisions_made.reason: Ensures WYSIWYG print output. FitToPage was distorting font sizes.

decisions_made.decision: Use add_bom_safe.ps1 script for encoding protection
decisions_made.reason: PowerShell Get-Content/Set-Content caused double-encoding (Mojibake). The safe script inserts BOM bytes without re-interpreting file content.

errors_encountered.error: Mojibake (Vietnamese character corruption) in Excel output
errors_encountered.root_cause: PowerShell encoding conversion read UTF-8 bytes as Windows-1252, causing double-encoding
errors_encountered.resolution: Reverted to clean git state, reapplied changes, used add_bom_safe.ps1 for BOM insertion

context_checkpoints.summary: Excel BOM formatting complete. 3 sheets standardized: A4 Landscape, 9pt TNR, No Scaling, fixed 135-unit total width. Mojibake resolved. Latest release: v0.2.75.
